2. GCD of 81 and 27 using binary algorithm. Binary algorithm (Stein's algorithm). Compute gcd(81,27). Both odd? 81 odd, 27 odd. gcd(81,27) = gcd((81-27)/2,27) = gcd(54/2=27,27) = gcd(27,27) = 27. So gcd=27.

3. LCM of 15 and 25 using standard algorithm. Standard algorithm: lcm(a,b) = |a*b| / gcd(a,b). gcd(15,25)=5. So lcm = 15*25/5 = 75.

4. LCM of 21 and 14 using reduced algorithm. Reduced algorithm: lcm(a,b) = a/gcd(a,b)*b. gcd(21,14)=7. So lcm = 21/7*14 = 3*14 = 42.
